title: Queue-flake anchor: packages/qa/scenarios/test/skill-evals/skill-evals.test.ts — '--regrade grades an old answer only against the case that ran' times out at 5000 ms under queue load
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Queue-flake anchor, filed by triage (R1208).

## Hits (Test Core, `@objectstack/scenarios`)
- 2026-11-17 20:50Z: #34752's merge group, run 44173524776, Test Core 7/10.
- 2026-11-18 01:07Z: #34709's merge group, run 44213369286, Test Core 7/10.

Both fail the same case, `skill-evals.test.ts` › "--regrade grades an old answer only against the case that ran" › "the command: a reworded case keeps its recor…", with **Test timed out in 5000ms**. Neither PR touches `packages/qa/scenarios`.

## Reading
This is one root: a case that shells out to the `skill-evals` command (from #34764 / #34841), running against vitest's default 5 s timeout, under full-queue load. It is the same class as #34834's LIT case.

## Done when
Either give the case a timeout sized from a measured CI duration, with the measurement in a comment, or make the case cheaper (call the regrade function in process instead of spawning the command). Then pin it, and check it under `--repeat` locally.

Grade: **p2 · domain:devx** under the queue-flake rule (#34152): one independent root, so p2 and no jump, even across two heads. It is raised to p0 only if a second, independent root appears.
